credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Repurposed Japan Air Lines stationary box containing 11 matchboxes from various Japanese restaurants and hotels. Also contained in the box is a Japan Air Lines notepad and a Japanese Air Lines envelope decorated with their abstract violet crane motif. The covers on both sides of the box is a blue/gray Japanese paper printed with 6 circular discs representing an abstract crane motif in green, orange and dark Indigo blue. The interior of the box is lines with handmade Japanese paper with visible fibers.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Addison Doty
title: Japanese Air Lines Stationary Box with Matchboxes
